messages:
Priya K: Heads-up — PR 142 (migration guide: v1->v2 endpoints) needs reviewers before EOD. CI is green but docs preview failed for one link.
Alex M: linking the preview: https://deploy-preview-142--redwood-docs.netlify.app/
Alex M: error is the internal link to /dedicated/config missing anchor, simple fix.
Dave R: I can take a pass on the migration flow (sequence diagrams + example curl). Prefer to review after the link fix.
Priya K: Thanks Dave. Assigning you now. @Sasha L can you do a quick pass on the SDK snippet updates? There's a JS -> Py parity check needed.
Sasha L: Yep I'll check the python snippet tonight. If small, can approve tomorrow morning.
Marta S: I'm out today but can review merge-time items (release note blurb + TOC) tomorrow.
Alex M: Docs-bot shows CI: lint passed, tests passed, docs-preview: failed (1 broken link). Command: `yarn docs:preview --pr 142`
docs-bot: :robot_face: Report: 1 broken link at /docs/migrate#dedicated-config-anchor
Priya K: Quick plan: Dave fixes anchor; Sasha checks SDK parity; Alex re-runs preview; if green, we merge after 10:30am PST to fit docs deploy window.
Alex M: I'll be on merge duty. Requesting reviewers: Dave R (content), Sasha L (snippets), Marta S (post-merge notes) — please reply with :thumbsup: if you can.
Dave R: :thumbsup:
Sasha L: :thumbsup:
Marta S: :thumbsup: (will do notes tomorrow)
Priya K: Great — small follow-ups: add `BREAKING.md` note under migration guide? not necessary for minor anchor change. If anything substantive added, we re-run checks.
Alex M: Agreed. If preview remains flaky, we can delay merge to next deploy window. Otherwise merging after all approvals.
Sasha L: FYI, SDK reviewer rotation calendar shows a one-week gap next Tue; I'll update the doc to request backup reviewer.
Priya K: Thanks. I'll add an action item to docs-ownership spreadsheet: column 'backup reviewer' for SDKs.
Alex M: I'll merge PR 142 at 10:40am PST if preview green. Tagging this thread with #merge-plan
Priya K: Thanks team :rocket:
